metadata.description: Learning plans built on Test-Teach-Test, with an aha-first explanation of the hardest principles at High school, Master's or Advanced level.

plugins.name: training-plan
plugins.description: Generate a training plan for any learning goal, pitched at High school, Master's or Advanced level. Hard principles are taught through a failed prediction, one insight and a climb through the levels, with fully worked exercises. Includes a Socratic mode, session checkpoints, a learner profile and a concept library.
